title: Meetings & Events Deposit Relief for Group Room Blocks Interim Deposits
content:
A Group Room Blocks interim deposit carries an event-deposit relief that follows the organiser's Meetings & Events contract linked to the block. The relief is subtracted from the interim percentage:

- when that Meetings & Events contract is **definite** and the deposit it holds is **at least 3000 USD**, the relief is **5** percentage points;
- when that contract is **definite** and the deposit it holds is **below 3000 USD**, the relief is **2.5** percentage points;
- when the organiser holds no definite event contract linked to the block, there is no relief.

**Records read.** The Meetings & Events contract that names this group room block as the block contracted alongside the event, its status, and the event deposit it currently holds.

### Status and deposit combined

| Linked Meetings & Events contract | Event deposit held | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| definite | 3,000.00 USD or more | 5 points |
| definite | below 3,000.00 USD | 2.5 points |
| tentative, cancelled or any status other than definite | any | none |
| no contract linked to the block | — | none |

### Boundary (hypothetical event deposits on a definite contract)

| Event deposit held | Relief |
|---|---|
| 3,000.00 USD | 5 points |
| 2,999.99 USD | 2.5 points |
| 0.00 USD | 2.5 points |
